ja461:1.1: Etha Lakkhaṇa Sītā ca ubho otarathodakan ti. Evāyaṃ Bharato āha: rājā Dasaratho mato ti.
ja461:2.1: Kena Rāma ppabhāvena socitabbaṃ na socasi, pitaraṃ kālakataṃ sutvā na taṃ pasahate dukhan ti.
ja461:3.1: Yaṃ na sakkā pāletuṃ posena lapataṃ bahuṃ sa kissa viññū medhāvī attānam upatāpaye.
ja461:4.1: Daharā ca hi vuddhā ca ye bālā ye ca paṇḍitā aḍḍhā c' eva daliddā ca sabbe maccuparāyanā.
ja461:5.1: Phalānam iva pakkānaṃ niccaṃ papatanā bhayaṃ evaṃ jātānaṃ maccānaṃ niccaṃ maraṇato bhayaṃ.
ja461:6.1: Sāyam eke na dissanti pāto diṭṭhā bahujjanā, pāto eke na dissanti sāyaṃ diṭṭhā bahujjanā.
ja461:7.1: Paridevayamāno ce kañcid atthaṃ udabbahe sammūḷho hiṃsam attānaṃ kayira c' enaṃ vicakkhaṇo.
ja461:8.1: Kiso vivaṇṇo bhavati hiṃsam attānam attano, na tena petā pālenti, niratthā paridevanā.
ja461:9.1: Yathā saranam ādittam vārinā parinibbaye evam pi dhīro sutavā medhavī paṇḍito naro khippam uppatitaṃ sokaṃ vāto tūlaṃ va dhaṃsaye.
ja461:10.1: Eko va macco acceti, eko va jāyate kule, saññogaparamā tv-eva sambhogā sabbapāṇinaṃ.
ja461:11.1: Tasmā hi dhīrassa bahussutassa sampassato lokam imaṃ parañ ca aññāya dhammaṃ hadayaṃ manañ ca sokā mahantāpi na tāpayanti.
ja461:12.1: So 'haṃ dassañ ca bhokkhañ ca bharissāmi ca ñātake, sesaṃ sampālayissāmi, kiccam evaṃ vijānato ti.
ja461:13.1: Dasa vassasahassāni saṭṭhi vassasatāni ca kambugīvo mahābāhu Rāmo rajjam akārayīti
